name: Two Faults, Twelve Minutes
brief:
The U6 mastery gate. Two faults of different kinds have been planted in the reference topology: one is addressing, one is not. Find both, fix both, verify both, inside twelve minutes.

Narrate your reasoning out loud as you go — your coach is listening for the sequence, not for the fix.
watchFor: Fix one thing at a time and re-test after each change. Two simultaneous edits and a still-broken ping tells you nothing.

tasks.text: Start with ipconfig on both PCs and a ping to each gateway.
Check interface status on R1 with show ip interface brief.
tasks.hint: One interface is administratively down. That is a one-line fix once you see it.

tasks.text: Fix fault one: bring R1 GigabitEthernet0/1 back up.
Fix fault two: correct PC2 subnet mask to 255.255.255.0.
tasks.hint: A /16 mask makes PC2 believe the whole 192.168.0.0 range is local, so its replies never reach its gateway.

extension: Run it again from a reset and beat your own time. Then have a teammate plant two different faults for you using the sandbox.
debrief:
The two faults fail differently and that is the lesson. The shut interface shows up immediately in `show ip interface brief`; the wrong mask shows up nowhere except in `ipconfig` on the host that has it, and only if you read the mask line rather than the address line.

After a mock round, sort your lost points into knowledge, speed and process. This lab is where process shows up.
